description: React component for rendering a sidebar category with drag-and-drop, accessibility, and category-specific controls in Mattermost.

classes.name: SidebarCategory
classes.description: React component class for a sidebar category with drag-and-drop, accessibility, and category-specific controls.

methods.description: Renders individual channel item within the category.
